It is a name that evokes a sense of spiritual dedication and commitment to one's faith. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Anniyah usually hope their child will grow to embody she who is devoted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
